# ghx command reference

Every command prints one JSON document (or a spill result). Errors are `{"error":{"code","message","hint","details"}}` with a non-zero exit. `ghx <cmd> --help` and `ghx <cmd> --schema` print the same information as JSON.

- [`ghx ci rerun`](#ghx-ci-rerun) (write): Rerun failed jobs of completed runs on the PR head (--flaky: only likely-flaky jobs)
- [`ghx ci retrigger`](#ghx-ci-retrigger) (write): Fire fresh pull_request workflows by closing and reopening the PR (never left closed)
- [`ghx ci wait`](#ghx-ci-wait) (read): Wait for CI on a PR or branch; one JSON summary, exit code = outcome (run in background)
- [`ghx ci why`](#ghx-ci-why) (read): Why CI is red: failing jobs, step, tests, errors, log path, shared-with-main and flake
- [`ghx doctor`](#ghx-doctor) (read): Check the setup: gh version and features, auth, git, the target repo and its config.
- [`ghx hook claude-pretooluse`](#ghx-hook-claude-pretooluse) (read): Claude Code PreToolUse hook: background ghx ci wait, steer raw gh to ghx (stdin protocol)
- [`ghx init`](#ghx-init) (write): Write a starter .github/ghx.json (components inferred from the workspace).
- [`ghx pr comment`](#ghx-pr-comment) (write): Post a typed coordination comment: note, merge precondition, status or supersede
- [`ghx pr create`](#ghx-pr-create) (write): Open a PR from validated JSON: compact body, hidden ghx block, exact read-back
- [`ghx pr edit`](#ghx-pr-edit) (write): Patch a ghx PR: re-validated, block rev+1, retarget or draft toggle, exact read-back
- [`ghx pr feedback`](#ghx-pr-feedback) (read): All PR feedback (reviews, findings, comments, bots), filterable; full bodies in a file
- [`ghx pr merge`](#ghx-pr-merge) (write): Merge when policy allows, pinned to the evaluated head; every blocker reported together
- [`ghx pr resolve`](#ghx-pr-resolve) (write): Set the status of findings or preconditions (append-only event; resolves the review thread)
- [`ghx pr review`](#ghx-pr-review) (write): Post a review: verdict, inline findings in the diff, hidden blocks, pinned to the head
- [`ghx pr status`](#ghx-pr-status) (read): One object: description, block, merge readiness, CI for the head, feedback, preconditions, stack
- [`ghx version`](#ghx-version) (read): Print the ghx version, Node version and platform (no gh calls).

## Passthrough reads

These gh reads run through ghx in a bounded JSON envelope (`{passthrough:{argv, exitCode, json|text|stdoutPath, stdoutBytes, stderr}}`): `ghx pr diff`, `ghx pr list`, `ghx issue view`, `ghx issue list`, `ghx search issues`, `ghx search prs`, `ghx search code`, `ghx search repos`, `ghx search commits`, `ghx release list`, `ghx release view`, `ghx repo view`, `ghx workflow list`, `ghx workflow view`, `ghx run list`, `ghx run view`, `ghx run download`, `ghx label list`, `ghx api`. `api` is GET only; `run view` without `--log`; `run download` needs `-D <dir>`. Commands ghx wraps (`gh pr view`, `gh pr checks`, `gh run view --log`, `gh pr merge`, …) are refused with the exact replacement; other writes are refused.

## ghx ci rerun

Rerun failed jobs of completed runs on the PR head (--flaky: only likely-flaky jobs)

`ghx ci rerun <pr> [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 2m (max 5m).

Reruns the failed jobs of completed Actions runs for the current head, skipping runs still in progress (RUN_IN_PROGRESS) and runs at ci.maxRerunAttempts (RERUN_LIMIT, default 3). --job reruns matching jobs; --flaky only jobs with flake evidence (NO_FLAKY_CANDIDATES if none), never widening to a real failure: one job per run at a time, the rest DEFERRED until that run completes. A rerun reuses the original merge ref: after a base change, use ghx ci retrigger.

Flags:

- `--job <string>` (repeatable): Only failed jobs whose name matches (repeatable; * and ?)
- `--flaky` (default `false`): Only jobs whose flake score is medium or higher (02 §11.8)
- `--expect-head <string>`: Refuse with HEAD_MOVED unless the head is this SHA
- `--override <string>` (repeatable): RERUN_LIMIT: rerun past ci.maxRerunAttempts
- `--reason <string>`: Why the override is allowed (who asked); required with --override

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Replaces: `gh run rerun`, `gh run rerun --failed`, `gh run rerun --job`.

Examples:

- `ghx ci rerun powerhouse-inc/powerhouse#3301 --flaky`: Rerun only the jobs that look flaky
- `ghx ci rerun 3301`: Rerun every failed job of the completed runs on the head
- `ghx ci rerun 3301 --job 'Test Reactor*'`: Rerun matching failed jobs
- `ghx ci rerun 3301 --override RERUN_LIMIT --reason "user asked in chat"`: Past ci.maxRerunAttempts

Schema: `ghx ci rerun --schema`.

## ghx ci retrigger

Fire fresh pull_request workflows by closing and reopening the PR (never left closed)

`ghx ci retrigger <pr> [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 3m (max 10m).

Closes and reopens the PR so GitHub runs its pull_request workflows on the current merge ref (a rerun reuses the old one). Refuses unless the PR is open, its head and base branches exist and you authored it (AUTHOR_NOT_VIEWER, overridable). A failed reopen is retried, then REOPEN_FAILED. Afterwards it looks for new check suites on the head for --wait-for-runs (default 60s) and warns NO_NEW_RUNS if none appear.

Flags:

- `--expect-head <string>`: Refuse with HEAD_MOVED unless the head is this SHA
- `--wait-for-runs <string>` (default `"60s"`): How long to look for new check suites after the reopen (e.g. 60s, 2m; max 5m)
- `--override <string>` (repeatable): AUTHOR_NOT_VIEWER: retrigger someone else's PR
- `--reason <string>`: Why the override is allowed (who asked); required with --override

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Replaces: `gh pr close <n> && gh pr reopen <n>`.

Examples:

- `ghx ci retrigger powerhouse-inc/powerhouse#3301`: Close and reopen to fire pull_request CI
- `ghx ci retrigger 3301 --expect-head 9f2c4e1`: Refuse if the head moved
- `ghx ci retrigger 3169 --override AUTHOR_NOT_VIEWER --reason "user asked in chat"`: Someone else's PR, when the user asked

Schema: `ghx ci retrigger --schema`.

## ghx ci wait

Wait for CI on a PR or branch; one JSON summary, exit code = outcome (run in background)

`ghx ci wait <targets…> [flags]`

read, stream, no deadline.

Run `ghx ci wait <pr>` with the Bash tool and `run_in_background: true`. Then continue other work or end your turn. Do not poll, sleep, or use Monitor for CI. You will be re-invoked when it exits. Its stdout is the full answer and its exit code is the outcome (§6.1). The summary is never spilled: it is compacted to 16 KB, and --max-bytes and GHX_MAX_BYTES are ignored.

Flags:

- `--until <first-failure|settled|mergeable>` (default `"first-failure"`): first-failure: return at the first new failure or settled green; settled: wait for everything; mergeable: settled, then the merge CI gate (PR targets only)
- `--any` (default `false`): Return when the first target reaches a terminal state
- `--on-head-change <restart|stop|stay>`: On a head change: restart (PR default), stop (exit 12) or stay (branch default)
- `--check <string>` (repeatable): Only checks whose name matches (repeatable; globs)
- `--diagnose` (default `true`): Diagnose each failure as it lands; --no-diagnose skips it
- `--compare-main` (default `true`): Compare failures with the default branch; --no-compare-main skips it
- `--stream` (default `false`): Print every event as NDJSON (for humans; agents use the default)

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Replaces: `gh pr checks --watch`, `gh run watch`, `gh pr checks`, `gh run list`.

Examples:

- `ghx ci wait 3301 -R powerhouse-inc/powerhouse`: Run with run_in_background: true
- `ghx ci wait owner/repo#12 --until settled`: Wait for every check, not the first failure
- `ghx ci wait owner/repo#12 --until mergeable`: Settled CI, then the merge CI gate
- `ghx ci wait branch:main@9f2c4e1 -R owner/repo`: CI for one commit on a branch
- `ghx ci wait owner/repo#12 owner/repo#13 --any`: Return at the first target that finishes

Schema: `ghx ci wait --schema`.

## ghx ci why

Why CI is red: failing jobs, step, tests, errors, log path, shared-with-main and flake

`ghx ci why [<pr>] [flags]`

read, single document, timeout 2m (max 5m).

Diagnoses the failing checks on a PR head (or one workflow run, --run) in one call. Logs come from the jobs API, so a finished job is diagnosed while the rest of its run is still going. Full logs are written to files (logPath). Green jobs whose ci.keySteps step was skipped are listed in suspicious.

Flags:

- `--run <string>`: A workflow run id or URL, instead of a PR
- `--job <string>` (repeatable): Only failing jobs whose name matches (repeatable; * and ?)
- `--compare-main` (default `true`): Compare failures with the default branch; --no-compare-main skips it
- `--max-jobs <integer>` (default `5`): Failing jobs to diagnose
- `--excerpt-lines <integer>` (default `20`): Log excerpt lines per job

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Replaces: `gh run view --log`, `gh run view --log-failed`, `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/actions/jobs/{id}/logs`.

Examples:

- `ghx ci why 3301 -R powerhouse-inc/powerhouse`: Diagnose the failing checks on PR #3301
- `ghx ci why owner/repo#12 --job 'Test*'`: Only jobs whose name starts with Test
- `ghx ci why --run 37948190914 -R owner/repo`: One workflow run, without a PR
- `ghx ci why 12 --no-compare-main`: Skip the comparison with the default branch

Schema: `ghx ci why --schema`.

## ghx hook claude-pretooluse

Claude Code PreToolUse hook: background ghx ci wait, steer raw gh to ghx (stdin protocol)

`ghx hook claude-pretooluse`

read, single document, timeout 1m (max 5m).

Reads the PreToolUse event JSON on stdin (the one command that does; Claude Code delivers it there) and prints a hook reply or nothing. A Bash `ghx ci wait` without run_in_background gets updatedInput with run_in_background: true and no permission decision. A gh CI polling loop (Bash or Monitor) or a gh command ghx wraps gets permissionDecision ask (GHX_HOOK_MODE=deny|ask|off; default ask) naming the ghx replacement. Fails open: any error or unparseable stdin exits 0 with no output. No gh calls. Register it with matcher Bash|Monitor (docs/agents/hooks.md).

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Examples:

- `ghx hook claude-pretooluse`: Run by Claude Code with the event on stdin; settings: matcher "Bash|Monitor"

Schema: `ghx hook claude-pretooluse --schema`.

## ghx init

Write a starter .github/ghx.json (components inferred from the workspace).

`ghx init [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 1m (max 5m).

Flags:

- `--component <string>` (repeatable): Component name (repeatable); skips inference
- `--force` (default `false`): Overwrite an existing config

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Examples:

- `ghx init --component reactor --component codegen`

## ghx pr comment

Post a typed coordination comment: note, merge precondition, status or supersede

`ghx pr comment <pr> [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 1m (max 5m).

Write {kind, …} with your file tool and pass --input c.json. Kinds: note {body}; precondition {condition: {type: pr-merged|release-includes, ref} | {type: manual, text}}; status {state, body, refs?}; supersede {by}. Refs must exist and not be this PR. --close closes the PR (not with a precondition).

Flags:

- `--close` (default `false`): Close the PR after commenting (not with a precondition)

JSON-only fields: `kind`, `body`, `condition`, `state`, `refs`, `by`.

Input: JSON input is required: write it to a file, then ghx pr comment --input file.json (or --input -).

Replaces: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr close --comment`.

Examples:

- `ghx pr comment octo/demo#7 --input -`: or --input c.json
- `ghx pr comment 7 --input note.json`: {"kind":"note","body":"…"}
- `ghx pr comment 7 --input s.json --close`: {"kind":"supersede","by":"#9"}, then close

Schema: `ghx pr comment --schema`.

## ghx pr create

Open a PR from validated JSON: compact body, hidden ghx block, exact read-back

`ghx pr create [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 2m (max 10m).

Write the PR object with your file tool and pass --input pr.json. Draft and stackedOn are derived from the base. Fails with every input issue at once (VALIDATION), DUPLICATE_PR when the head already has an open PR.

Flags:

- `--batch`: Create several PRs from {defaults, items} (02 §2.4)

JSON-only fields: `title`, `description`, `testing`, `risk`, `riskNote`, `components`, `revertPolicy`, `revertNote`, `revertWith`, `base`, `head`, `draft`, `refs`, `defaults`, `items`.

Input: JSON input is required: write it to a file, then ghx pr create --input file.json (or --input -).

Replaces: `gh pr create`.

Examples:

- `ghx pr create -R octo/demo --input -`: or --input pr.json
- `ghx pr create --input pr.json --dry-run`: validate, check and render without creating
- `ghx pr create --batch --input prs.json`: several PRs: {defaults, items}; stacked items in order

Schema: `ghx pr create --schema`.

## ghx pr edit

Patch a ghx PR: re-validated, block rev+1, retarget or draft toggle, exact read-back

`ghx pr edit <pr> [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 2m (max 10m).

Write the patch with your file tool and pass --input patch.json; only the fields to change. DESCRIPTION_DRIFT when the visible text was edited in the UI (include it, or --discard-ui-edits); NO_BLOCK unless "adopt": true with the full object. GH_FORBIDDEN unless you have write access or opened the PR yourself (GitHub lets authors edit their own PRs). CONCURRENT_EDIT when the title or body changed since the read; GitHub has no If-Match, so an edit made in the moment between the final re-read and the PATCH is still overwritten.

Flags:

- `--discard-ui-edits`: Proceed when the visible description or title was edited outside ghx; the block wins

JSON-only fields: `title`, `description`, `testing`, `risk`, `riskNote`, `components`, `revertPolicy`, `revertNote`, `revertWith`, `base`, `draft`, `refs`, `adopt`.

Input: JSON input is required: write it to a file, then ghx pr edit --input file.json (or --input -).

Replaces: `gh pr edit`, `gh pr ready`.

Examples:

- `ghx pr edit octo/demo#12 --input -`: or --input patch.json
- `ghx pr edit 12 --input patch.json --dry-run`: validate and render without editing
- `ghx pr edit 12 --input ready.json`: {"draft": false} marks it ready for review

Schema: `ghx pr edit --schema`.

## ghx pr feedback

All PR feedback (reviews, findings, comments, bots), filterable; full bodies in a file

`ghx pr feedback <pr> [flags]`

read, single document, timeout 1m (max 5m).

Folds issue comments, reviews and inline threads into reviews, findings, comments and bots; unstructured items are kept with structured:false. --open keeps what still needs action. Bodies are capped at 2,000 chars inline; artifactPath holds the same document with every body in full.

Flags:

- `--open` (default `false`): Only what is still open: open findings, unresolved human threads, unmet preconditions, change requests
- `--source <ghx|human|bot>`: Only ghx (structured), human or bot items
- `--since <string>`: Only items newer than an ISO time or a commit SHA's date
- `--include-outdated` (default `false`): With --open, keep findings on outdated lines too

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Replaces: `gh pr view --comments`, `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/comments`, `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/comments`.

Examples:

- `ghx pr feedback 3301 -R powerhouse-inc/powerhouse --open`: What is still open on #3301
- `ghx pr feedback owner/repo#12 --source human`: Only human, unstructured feedback
- `ghx pr feedback 12 --since 9f2c4e1`: Only feedback newer than that commit

Schema: `ghx pr feedback --schema`.

## ghx pr merge

Merge when policy allows, pinned to the evaluated head; every blocker reported together

`ghx pr merge <pr> [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 3m (max 10m).

Runs the same checks as ghx pr status merge.ready, then merges with REST PUT pulls/N/merge pinned to the evaluated head. MERGE_BLOCKED lists every blocker: exit 9 when all are GitHub state (wait or fix, then re-run), 6 when a ghx policy refused (ask the user; --override CODE --reason "…" only if they accept). Squash or rebase only with an explicit --method that config allows. --dry-run prints the exact PUT.

Flags:

- `--expect-head <string>`: Refuse with HEAD_MOVED unless the head is this SHA (7–40 hex)
- `--method <merge|squash|rebase>`: merge (default: merge.method); squash or rebase only when config allows
- `--override <string>` (repeatable): Overridable blocker codes the user accepted (CODE or CODE,CODE); needs --reason
- `--reason <string>`: Why the override is allowed (who asked); one line, ≤200 chars
- `--delete-branch`: Delete the same-repo head branch after merging (default: merge.deleteBranch); remote ref only

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Replaces: `gh pr merge`, `gh pr merge --match-head-commit`, `gh api -X PUT repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}/merge`.

Examples:

- `ghx pr merge 3301 -R powerhouse-inc/powerhouse --expect-head 9f2c4e1`: Merge, pinned to 9f2c4e1
- `ghx pr merge owner/repo#12 --dry-run`: Every check and the exact PUT, without merging
- `ghx pr merge 12 --override AUTHOR_NOT_VIEWER --reason "user asked in chat"`: Merge someone else's PR because the user asked
- `ghx pr merge 12 --expect-head 9f2c4e1 --delete-branch`: Merge, then delete the remote head branch

Schema: `ghx pr merge --schema`.

## ghx pr resolve

Set the status of findings or preconditions (append-only event; resolves the review thread)

`ghx pr resolve <pr> <ids…> [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 1m (max 5m).

addressed needs --commit (in the PR); wontfix, deferred, met and withdrawn need --note. Ids come from ghx pr feedback. An inline finding gets a thread reply and its thread resolved; others get one issue comment. GitHub lists only the first 250 commits of a PR, so a --commit beyond them cannot be verified and is refused.

Flags:

- `--status <addressed|wontfix|deferred|open|met|withdrawn|unmet>` (required): Findings: addressed|wontfix|deferred|open; preconditions: met|withdrawn|unmet
- `--commit <string>`: The fix commit (required for addressed); must be in the PR
- `--note <string>`: One line, ≤200 chars (required for wontfix, deferred, met, withdrawn)
- `--tracking <string>`: Issue tracking deferred work: #N or owner/repo#N

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Examples:

- `ghx pr resolve octo/demo#7 f_h4x8pz --status addressed --commit bbbbbbb`: after pushing the fix
- `ghx pr resolve 7 f_n2c6rv --status wontfix --note "The id is logged one frame up."`
- `ghx pr resolve 7 c_a1b2c3 --status met --note "Ops confirmed the window."`: a manual precondition

Schema: `ghx pr resolve --schema`.

## ghx pr review

Post a review: verdict, inline findings in the diff, hidden blocks, pinned to the head

`ghx pr review <pr> [flags]`

write, single document, timeout 1m (max 5m).

Write {verdict, summary, scope?, findings[]} with your file tool and pass --input review.json. A finding goes inline only inside a diff hunk (else in the body, FINDING_NOT_INLINE). On your own PR the verdict posts as COMMENT (VERDICT_DOWNGRADED). --expect-head pins the head (HEAD_MOVED).

Flags:

- `--expect-head <string>`: Refuse with HEAD_MOVED unless the head is this SHA

JSON-only fields: `verdict`, `summary`, `scope`, `findings`.

Input: JSON input is required: write it to a file, then ghx pr review --input file.json (or --input -).

Replaces: `gh pr review`.

Examples:

- `ghx pr review octo/demo#7 --input -`: or --input review.json
- `ghx pr review 7 --input review.json --expect-head 9f2c4e1`: refuse if the head moved

Schema: `ghx pr review --schema`.

## ghx pr status

One object: description, block, merge readiness, CI for the head, feedback, preconditions, stack

`ghx pr status <pr> [flags]`

read, single document, timeout 2m (max 5m).

Answers "can this PR land, and what is left" in one call. merge.ready is exactly what ghx pr merge would decide now (same policy engine); merge.blockers say why not. CI is reported for the head SHA only. Feedback from all three GitHub sources is folded; bodies are capped, and the full text is in ghx pr feedback.

Flags:

- `--compare-main` (default `true`): Compare failing checks with the default branch; --no-compare-main skips it
- `--wait-mergeable` (default `true`): Retry an UNKNOWN mergeable for up to 20 s; --no-wait-mergeable reads it once

Input: Flags and positionals only; --input file.json is also accepted.

Replaces: `gh pr view`, `gh pr checks`, `gh pr view --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviews,comments`.

Examples:

- `ghx pr status 3301 -R powerhouse-inc/powerhouse`: Everything about PR #3301
- `ghx pr status owner/repo#12 --no-compare-main`: Skip the comparison with the default branch
- `ghx pr status 12 --no-wait-mergeable`: Read mergeable once, even if GitHub says UNKNOWN

Schema: `ghx pr status --schema`.
